properties.evidence: Cardiomyocyte-specific Top2b deletion protects mice from doxorubicin-induced DNA double-strand breaks, defective mitochondrial biogenesis, ROS formation and progressive heart failure (PMID:23104132, Nat Med 2012)

properties.mechanism: DNA topoisomerase II inhibitor + iron sequestering agent
properties.note: ChEMBL records topo II inhibition at target CHEMBL2094255 (isoform not disambiguated in the record)

properties.direction: NF1 loss upregulates BCL2L1 (Bcl-xL) via Ras/Erk1/2
properties.consequence: increased doxorubicin resistance in MPNST-derived Schwann cells

properties.reversal: BCL2L1 knockdown restores doxorubicin-induced apoptosis; very low-dose ABT-737 + doxorubicin is synergistic

properties.evidence: AXL strongly activated at 2 and 21 days after doxorubicin or kinase inhibition in NF1-MPNST tumorgrafts (PMID:32245042)
NFkB strongly activated and tightly correlated with AXL regardless of treatment or genomic context (PMID:32245042)
BRD4, EZH2 and TOP2A expression investigated as therapeutic targets in human NF1-derived MPNSTs (PMID:28813519)

properties.design: non-inferiority; PFS primary, cardiac endpoints secondary; MPNST an eligible histology
